+    cal = obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
+    K = np.asarray(cal['intrinsic_cv'])
+    T = np.asarray(cal['cam2world_gl'])
+    yy,xx = np.indices(dep.shape)
+    local = np.stack(((xx-K[0,2])*dep/K[0,0], -(yy-K[1,2])*dep/K[1,1], -dep), axis=-1)
+    xyz = local @ T[:3,:3].T + T[:3,3]
+    return im, xyz
+
+def palm(obs, guess=np.array([.03,.075,.74])):
+    im,p = cloud(obs,'top')
+    white = (im.min(axis=2)>170)&((im.max(axis=2).astype(int)-im.min(axis=2))<25)
+    # Palm top, excluding fingers and forearm, tracked around a moving guess.
+    mask = white & (np.abs(p-guess)<np.array([.055,.035,.032])).all(axis=2)
+    a = p[mask]
+    if len(a)<30: raise RuntimeError(f'palm lost: {len(a)} pixels at {guess}')
+    return np.median(a,axis=0),len(a)
+
+def send(r, q, seconds, note='', cameras=['top','oblique']):
+    n=max(1,int(round(seconds/DT)))
+    return r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(q)[None,:], dt=n*DT,
+                    interpolate='linear', cameras=cameras, video='frames',
+                    include_depth=True, note=note)
+
+def qnow(obs):
+    return np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:29],dtype=float)
+

+    for c,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'{OUT}/{label}_{c}.png')
